headline: Millicom Executes Acquisition Strategy in Latin America Following Entel Peru Deal
summary: Millicom shared details of its playbook for integrating acquired telecom operators, following its November agreement to buy Entel Peru for $1.714 billion.
why: Cross-border telecom acquisitions reshape regional market concentration, competitive landscapes, and debt structures for telecommunications providers.

impacts.name: Millicom International Cellular SA
impacts.why: Millicom is actively pursuing regional consolidation via acquisitions like Entel Peru.
